name: tsuppari-product-07d
status: Product Tsuppari art contract (ACTION-07D): the User-accepted SEPARATE strategy (ACTION-07C2 Play Test).
note: Two authored red Tsuppari poses are the only runtime sources. Each is normalized like the accepted idle red (one whole-sprite rotation so FRONT = local +X, explicit root, body core = 2R, exact /4 downscale). Blue reuses the accepted red -> blue rule of runtime_wrestler_recipe.json (single owner): local-Y reflection ((x, y) -> (x, H - y)) swaps the wrestler's hand, the mawashi-only recolor keeps it, so blue left = reflected red right and blue right = reflected red left (export_tsuppari.py OUTPUTS). The authored blue candidates (references) are normalized only for preview reference sheets and never become runtime textures.

measurement.method: Implemented by measure_tsuppari_pose.py (--check verifies this recipe). Each red pose is registered to the accepted idle red master (runtime_wrestler_recipe.json) with two torso landmarks measured on the source at 1/2 scale (BOX): H = hair blob centroid (max(R, G, B) < 80 and alpha > 200, 7 px opening = erosion then dilation to drop the outline, largest 4-connected component), B = mawashi centroid (pixels in the accepted recolor hue band with its saturation / value floors, every 4-connected component >= 5% of the largest). Centroids are pixel centers in source px; areas are counted at 1/2 scale and reported x 4. rotation delta = angle(H -> B) - idle angle(H -> B); scale s = mean(sqrt(hair area ratio), sqrt(mawashi area ratio)); the idle root and body-core points are carried by s * Rot(delta) about the H/B midpoint; source_front_deg = idle 160.7 + delta. The recorded values (front 0.1 deg, points 1 px) are what the exporter uses and must agree with a fresh measurement within the tolerance below; measurement_evidence is the exact helper output.
measurement.history: red_left values were recorded in ACTION-07C by an uncommitted earlier implementation of the same method (7 px erosion only); the helper reproduces them within 0.71 source px / 0.03 deg. red_right was recorded in ACTION-07C2 with this exact method. The accepted runtime pixels were not re-normalized.

red_left.hand_evidence: Faces image left like the idle master; the extended arm is the screen-lower one = the wrestler's LEFT (-Y after normalization).

red_right.hand_evidence: Faces image left like the idle master; the extended arm is the screen-upper one = the wrestler's RIGHT (+Y after normalization).

blue_left.hand_evidence: Faces image right; the extended arm is the screen-upper one = the wrestler's LEFT.
blue_left.note: Preview reference only (never a runtime source); normalization recorded in ACTION-07C against the screen-mirrored idle red, not checked by measure_tsuppari_pose.py.

blue_right.hand_evidence: Faces image right; the extended arm is the screen-lower one = the wrestler's RIGHT.
blue_right.note: Preview reference only (never a runtime source); normalization recorded in ACTION-07C against the screen-mirrored idle red, not checked by measure_tsuppari_pose.py.

mask_limits.note: Per-pose validation of the accepted hue-band + largest-component mawashi mask at runtime scale (fail closed). missed = band pixels outside the largest component.
